<noinclude>
This is the "Safety Certification" form.

To create a page with this form, enter the page name below;
if a page with that name already exists, you will be sent to a form to edit that page.

{{#forminput:form=Safety Certification|autocomplete on category=Safety Certification}}
</noinclude>
<includeonly>
<div id="wikiPreview" style="display: none; padding-bottom: 25px; margin-bottom: 25px; border-bottom: 1px solid #AAAAAA;"></div>

{{{for template|Safety Certification}}}

{| class="formtable"
|-
! Certification Name:
| {{{field|name|mandatory|input type=text|size=80}}}
|-
! Certification Type:
| {{{field|type|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Biosafety,Radiation Safety,Chemical Safety,Fire Safety,Electrical Safety,Other}}}
|-
! Issuing Body:
| {{{field|issuing_body|mandatory|input type=text|size=80}}}
|-
! Issue Date:
| {{{field|issue_date|mandatory|input type=date}}}
|-
! Expiry Date:
| {{{field|expiry_date|mandatory|input type=date}}}
|-
! Validity Period:
| {{{field|validity_period|input type=text|size=30}}}
|-
! Required For Equipment:
| {{{field|required_for_equipment|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Equipment|delimiter=;}}}
|-
! Required For Protocol:
| {{{field|required_for_protocol|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Protocol|delimiter=;}}}
|-
! Personnel with Certification:
| {{{field|personnel_with_certification|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Personnel|delimiter=;}}}
|-
! Status:
| {{{field|status|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Active,Expired,Revoked|default=Active}}}
|}

{{{end template}}}

'''Free text:'''

{{{standard input|free text|rows=10}}}
</includeonly>
